reason: This is a remand order with several distinct directions the rubric specifically flags (remand, qualifications, directions): (1) the High Court is given liberty to frame additional substantial questions of law, not just the three noted; (2) the restored appeals are to be listed before the roster Bench on a specific date (27th August 2024), with parties obligated to appear without fresh notice; (3) interim relief operative as of the impugned judgment is expressly continued; (4) pending applications, including an impleadment application, are disposed of. None of these appear in the Conclusion.

"Filmistan appealed to the Supreme Court by special leave" is a party-role reversal. The High Court ruled in Filmistan's favor (upheld res judicata, blocked the trial from proceeding). The judgment's costs order "Filmistan will pay the costs of the appeal" confirms Filmistan lost this SC appeal, meaning Filmistan was the respondent, not the appellant.
